summary: Lists path tests on the control node (renamed without is_ in 2.5): directory, file, link, exists, abs, same_file, mount.
questions: How do I check if a path is a directory in a when condition?
Do path tests check the remote host?
How do I test if a path is a symlink or mount point?

answer_card.title: Path tests
answer_card.answer_md:
These test paths on the **control node** (the `is_` prefix was dropped in 2.5):

```yaml
when: mypath is directory
when: mypath is file
when: mypath is link
when: mypath is exists
when: mypath is same_file(path2)
when: mypath is mount
msg: "{{ (mypath is abs) | ternary('absolute','relative') }}"
```
